addedMedia.title: Playa Viva Regenerative Bamboo Treehouse Sanctuary on the Pacific Coast
addedMedia.caption:
It was never meant to be finished! Nearly 20 years ago, our founders stood on the beach with a vision to create a property that works as hard to regenerate the land as it does to create transformative guest experiences. We like to say that Playa Viva has evolved like nature, from a turtle sanctuary and coconut grove to a turtle sanctuary, 20-acre permaculture farm, rewilded lands, and a hotel. From 5 rooms to 20, we love how these photos show that natural evolution and how the stewardship of this land has brought abundance in many forms to our pristine stretch of the Pacific.

We are so fortunate to have guests who have been with us since the very beginning. Do you recognise the 'before' editions of Playa Viva in these photos? 

As the team works to prepare for Playa Viva's 18th season, we are looking forward to welcoming faces old and new back to our casa on the playa. Book in now to be part of the 18th chapter of our evolution.
